properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 6:51PM MST until September 13 at 8:30PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 651 PM MST /751 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain over
Cottonwood Wash had ended. Between 1.5 and 3 inches of rain have
fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, highways, roads and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Navajo County.

This includes Interstate 40 between mile markers 260 and 261.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Billy Wash, Cottonwood Wash, Pueblo Colorado Wash, Fern Feather
Wash, Humpy Wash, Little Colorado River, Manila Wash and Blairs
Spring Wash.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

NWSheadline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 830 PM MST /930 PM MDT/ THIS EVENING FOR NAVAJO COUNTY

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 13 at 6:51PM MST until September 13 at 7:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 651 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles east of
Nogales International Airport, moving northeast at 5 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Kino Springs.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

Wind damage with this storm will occur before any rain or lightning.
Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover. Seek
shelter immediately inside a sturdy structure and stay away from
windows.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 13 at 6:29PM MST until September 13 at 7:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
SVRTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
South Central Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 715 PM MST.

* At 629 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located near
Bisbee-Douglas Airport, moving north at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Douglas, Bisbee-Douglas Airport, Pirtleville and McNeal.

This includes the following highways...
Route 80 between mile markers 353 and 371. Route 191 between mile
markers 1 and 18.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 6:25PM MST until September 13 at 11:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 625 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain over the Havasu Creek basin. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.
A stream gage on Cataract Creek below Topocoba Gorge near Supai
recorded around a 5.0 foot rise at 6:00 PM MST.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Havasu Creek basin.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Havasu Creek basin.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Navajo Falls, Mooney Falls, Beaver Falls, Hualapai Hilltop,
Havasupai Reservation and Supai.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River, Sinyella Canyon, Heather Wash, Pasture Wash, Little
Coyote Canyon, Havasu Creek and Black Tank Wash.
properties.instruction:
Campers and hikers should hustle to higher ground immediately! Stay
away from creeks and washes!

Foot bridges will be washed out in Supai Campground. Some campsites
will be flooded. Campers may be stranded in portions of the
campground.

NWSheadline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING FOR THE HAVASU CREEK BASIN REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 PM MST THIS EVENING FOR COCONINO COUNTY

Willows Camp.

Tappan Spring.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Lee Canyon, Burro Canyon Wash, Needmore Wash, Little Colorado
River, Tappan Wash and Cedar Wash.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 6:57PM MST until September 13 at 9:00PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 900 PM MST.

* At 657 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.7 and 1.3 inches of
rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Southern Cochise County.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 13 at 7:09PM EDT until September 14 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Norton has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Rhode Island...

Pawtuxet River At Cranston affecting Kent and Providence Counties.

For the Pawtuxet River...including Cranston, Scituate Reservoir...
Minor flooding is forecast.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 200 AM EDT.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pawtuxet River at Cranston.

* WHEN...From this evening to late tonight.

* IMPACTS...At 9.0 feet, Minor lowland flooding will occur along the
river as it flows through Warwick and Cranston.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 6:45 PM EDT Sunday the stage was 9.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 9.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 9.1 feet
this evening. It will then fall below flood stage just after
midnight tonight.
- Flood stage is 9.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 9.1
feet on 11/06/1955.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
